notes:
• Now it's possible to also add .js files into the safe resource list manually.
  • Fixed an issue that plugins that even when Include Inactive Plugins are set to off, the app was scanning them anyway.
  • Fixed an issue that even when a plugin was not present in the plugins.js file(meaning, not ON or OFF on the plugin manager), the app was still scanning them.
  • Improved the UI in general:
    • Improved light and dark themes
    • Moved the theme selection to a panel on the top right of the app.
    • Improved selection of items to be more smooth
    • Buttons are no more just a rectangle
    • Implemented alternate colors on the lines of Unused, Used and Safe resource list
    • Moved the tiny icon that shows the image preview to the left side of the resource name
    • Improved the navigation on the navbar options to be like rpg maker editor: once opened an option, you can just hover the mouse on the other options that they will open too
